items.source: Note: please, review the Javadoc of queryParam(String, Object...) for further notes on the treatment and encoding of individual query parameters.
items.translation: 注意： 请查阅 queryParam(String, Object...) 的 Javadoc，以获取有关单个查询参数的处理和编码的进一步说明。

items.source: name - the query parameter name
items.translation: name - 查询参数名称

items.source: values - the query parameter values
items.translation: values - 查询参数值

items.source: Delegates to either queryParam(String, Object...) or queryParam(String, Collection) if the given Optional has a value, or else if it is empty, no query parameter is added at all.
items.translation: 委托给queryParam(String, Object...)或queryParam(String, Collection)，如果给定的Optional有值；否则，如果它是空的，则完全不添加查询参数。

items.source: port - the URI port
items.translation: port - URI 端口

items.source: the URI
items.translation: URI

items.source: Note: When inserting a URI variable value that contains slashes in a path, whether those are encoded depends on the configured encoding mode. For more details, see UriComponentsBuilder.encode(), or otherwise if building URIs indirectly via WebClient or RestTemplate, see its encodingMode. Also see the URI Encoding section of the reference docs.
items.translation: 注意： 在包含斜杠的 URI 变量值插入到path时，这些斜杠是否经过编码取决于配置的编码模式。有关详细信息，请参阅UriComponentsBuilder.encode()；或者如果通过WebClient或RestTemplate间接构建 URI，请参阅其encodingMode。另请参阅参考文档中的URI 编码部分。

items.source: Effectively a generalization of UriComponentsBuilder but with shortcuts to expand directly into URI rather than UriComponents and also leaving common concerns such as encoding preferences, a base URI, and others as implementation concerns.
items.translation: 实质上是对 UriComponentsBuilder 的泛化，但提供了直接展开为 URI 而非 UriComponents 的快捷方式，同时将编码偏好、基础 URI 等常见关注点作为实现细节处理。

items.source: Note: encoding, if applied, will only encode characters that are illegal in a query parameter name or value such as "=" or "&". All others that are legal as per syntax rules in RFC 3986 are not encoded. This includes "+" which sometimes needs to be encoded to avoid its interpretation as an encoded space. Stricter encoding may be applied by using a URI template variable along with stricter encoding on variable values. For more details please read the "URI Encoding" section of the Spring Framework reference.
items.translation: 注意： 如果应用编码，则仅对查询参数名称或值中非法的字符（例如 "=" 或 "&"）进行编码。所有符合RFC 3986语法规则的合法字符均不进行编码。这包括有时需要编码以避免被解释为已编码空格的 "+"。可以通过使用 URI 模板变量以及对变量值应用更严格的编码来实施更严格的编码。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 Spring Framework 参考中的"URI 编码"部分。

items.source: Typically obtained via UriBuilderFactory which serves as a central component configured once and used to create many URLs.
items.translation: 通常通过UriBuilderFactory获取，它作为中央组件被配置一次并用于创建许多 URL。

items.source: Set the URI port. Use this method only when the port needs to be parameterized with a URI variable. Otherwise use port(int). Passing null will clear the port of this builder.
items.translation: 设置 URI 端口。仅在需要以 URI 变量参数化端口时使用此方法；否则请使用port(int)。传递null将清除此构建器的端口。

items.source: Build a URI instance and replaces URI template variables with the values from an array.
items.translation: 构建一个 `URI` 实例，并用数组中的值替换 URI 模板变量。

items.source: Build a URI instance and replaces URI template variables with the values from a map.
items.translation: 构建一个 `URI` 实例，并用 Map 中的值替换 URI 模板变量。

items.source: Variant of queryParam(String, Object...) with a Collection.
items.translation: 带有 Collection 的 `queryParam(String, Object...)` 变体。

items.source: Clear existing query parameters and then delegate to query(String).
items.translation: 清除现有的查询参数，然后委托给query(String)。

items.source: Variant of replaceQueryParam(String, Object...) with a Collection.
items.translation: 带有集合的 `replaceQueryParam(String, Object...)` 变体。

items.source: Set the URI host which may contain URI template variables, and may also be null to clear the host of this builder.
items.translation: 设置可能包含 URI 模板变量的 URI 主机，也可以将其设置为 `null` 以清除此构建器的主机。

items.source: Set the URI scheme which may contain URI template variables, and may also be null to clear the scheme of this builder.
items.translation: 设置可能包含 URI 模板变量的 URI 方案，也可以设置为 `null` 以清除此构建器的方案。

items.source: Set the URI user info which may contain URI template variables, and may also be null to clear the user info of this builder.
items.translation: 设置可能包含 URI 模板变量的 URI 用户信息，也可以设置为 `null` 以清除此构建器的用户信息。

items.source: Set the URI port. Passing -1 will clear the port of this builder.
items.translation: 设置 URI 端口。传递 `-1` 将清除此构建器的端口。

items.source: Set the URI fragment. The given fragment may contain URI template variables, and may also be null to clear the fragment of this builder.
items.translation: 设置 URI 片段。给定的片段可能包含 URI 模板变量，也可以为 `null` 以清除此构建器的片段。

items.source: Set the URI port.
items.translation: 设置 URI 端口。

items.source: Override the current path.
items.translation: 覆盖当前路径。

items.source:
Return a String representation of the URI by concatenating all URI
component values into the fully formed URI String. Implementing classes
should perform simple String concatenation of current URI component
values to preserve URI template placeholders.
items.translation: 通过将所有 URI 组件值连接成完整的 URI 字符串来返回 URI 的字符串表示形式。实现类应对当前 URI 组件值执行简单的字符串连接，以保留 URI 模板占位符。

Parse the given query string into query parameters, and append them to

Set the query parameter values replacing existing values, or if no
values are given, the query parameter is removed.
items.translation: 设置查询参数值以替换现有值，或者如果未给定任何值，则移除该查询参数。

items.translation: 在删除所有现有值后，设置查询参数值。
